name: How do I choose the right style of window trim for my home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right style of window trim for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right window trim style involves considering your home's architectural style, the existing interior and exterior finishes, and your personal aesthetic preferences. Traditional homes often benefit from more ornate or multi-piece trim, while modern homes may suit simpler, cleaner profiles. It's helpful to look at examples in your neighborhood, like in Berkeley or Piedmont, to see what complements similar housing styles. Our design consultants can also provide guidance tailored to your home's character.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose window trim style by considering your home's architecture, existing finishes, and personal taste. Consult local examples or our design team for tailored guidance.
